answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 61397 Country: India Title: Interest and third party car insurance Question: As you know that third party car insurance is compulsory in India. We cannot drive a car without third party insurance. My salary is credited into saving bank account and I get interest on two occasions in a year on my money stored in the saving account. Can I pay third party insurance premium using the interest money? Answer ID: 61397 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 58/58/SD=02/1437) It is not lawful to pay third party insurance premium of car using interest money. (Ahsan a-Fatwa: 7l26, pub. Zakaria, Deoband) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
